builtBy: Local build on Windows 11 (x86_64), pinned nightly-2026-08-01. GitHub Actions was unavailable (the repository is private with no Actions minutes), so these are locally-built bytes, not a CI build. The build is deterministic: two full-clean builds on the same host (cargo clean of target/ and target-user/ between them) produced these exact digests. A Linux build (as CI produces) yields different bytes — Rust embeds the source path in panic locations, and the path separators differ (kernel\src on Windows, kernel/src on Linux) — so the CI-built SHA-256 will differ and will be added when the CI window opens.
reproducibility: Reproducible on the build host: two full-clean builds (target/ and target-user/ both removed between them, no shared cache for the kernel or the user programs) produced identical digests for every image. image-builder removes the non-determinism sources found in v0.8.1 (random GPT GUIDs; the link time and CodeView GUID in the embedded UEFI loader) and the user-program archive is a deterministic ustar. This release is Windows-built and reproducible on Windows; a Linux/CI build produces different bytes (path separators in panic-location strings) and is pending the CI window.
notice: v1.0.0 supersedes v0.10.0. It carries the V0.11 AI-native layer (never tagged on its own) and V1.0's reliability and security work: IPC channel scoping, a Ring 3 syscall fuzzer and a decoder mutation fuzzer, long-use leak accounting, contained CPU exceptions, and a whole-attack-surface adversarial review that fixed every high-severity defect and 18 findings in all. Seven medium findings are documented, accepted, fail-closed availability limits a capability holder or a hostile disk can impose on this single-user VM (see docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md). VERIFICATION: this release is verified locally, not by GitHub CI — the full local QEMU matrix (74 legs), two-clean-build reproducibility, and UEFI+BIOS boot-tests of these exact bytes; there is no CI run id yet. Earlier releases stay downloadable at /downloads/v0.10.0/, /downloads/v0.9.0/ and /downloads/v0.8.1/, each with its own SHA256SUMS.txt.
